|rulings=* When a player uses the card from [[Sando Aqua Monster (Dark){{!}}Sando Aqua Monster]] instead of drawing a weapon or battle destiny, they are performing a substituted destiny draw. The destiny value from the card on Sando is used, and it cannot be modified, canceled or reset and does not count towards limits on the number of destinies that may be drawn.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Sando%20Aqua%20Monster</ref>
* Although the substituted destiny value from [[Sando Aqua Monster (Dark){{!}}Sando Aqua Monster]] may not subsequently be modified (e.g. by [[Prepared Defenses]]), the destiny value of the stacked card could have already been subject to global modifiers (e.g. the Senate objectives can make senators globally destiny +2 or +3). Such global modifiers affect the card while it is on Sando, so they apply when the destiny substitution occurs.
